summary: NiCE announced a planned reduction of approximately 5% of its global workforce, reported as around 500 employees, while explicitly linking its operating-model changes to greater efficiency through AI. The company is also reducing management layers, simplifying decision-making and redirecting resources toward growth priorities including CX AI innovation. The exact headcount is undisclosed; approximately 500 is a reported estimate, not a company-confirmed tally or evidence that AI directly replaces every affected worker.
evidenceQuote: NiCE to streamline its operating model and drive greater efficiency by leveraging AI, reducing workforce by approximately 5%
notes: The November 4, 2026 official Q3 results announcement confirms the approximate 5% global reduction and explicitly identifies leveraging AI as an efficiency measure. CTech reports that this represents around 500 employees; this entry uses that approximate reported count, not an exact company disclosure. No geographic distribution is established. The restructuring also includes fewer management layers, simpler decision-making and stronger partner-led go-to-market and delivery capabilities, while maintaining investment in CX AI innovation, customer delivery and go-to-market capabilities. NiCE expects $15 million to $20 million in pretax restructuring costs, primarily in Q4 2026. These are planned workforce reductions, not a confirmed completed departure count. The company-stated AI connection applies to the broader operating-model transformation; it does not establish direct AI replacement of each eliminated role.

sources.name: NiCE official Q3 2026 results and restructuring announcement
